content: मर्द {%a.%} [मृद्-घञ्] Crushing, pounding, grinding, destroying <ab>&c.</ab> (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>). .{@-र्दः@} .²1 Grinding, pounding. .²2 A violent stroke, friction; सूर्यं हतप्रभं पश्य ग्रहमर्दं मिथो दिवि <ls>Bhāg. 1. 14. 17</ls>. .²3 A kind of instrument useful for calculation about eclipses.
